description: This file defines the ContactFormBase class, a PHP class extending PersonFormBase, providing methods for generating contact forms, handling form submissions, duplicate checks, and redirects within the SuiteCRM application. It includes functions for rendering forms, processing saves, and managing inbound email associations.

classes.name: ContactFormBase
classes.description: A PHP class for managing contact form rendering, validation, duplicate checking, and saving within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getDuplicateQuery
methods.description: Constructs and returns an SQL query string to check for duplicate contacts based on first and last name, considering optional record exclusion.

methods.name: getWideFormBody
methods.description: Generates HTML form markup for a wide contact form, including address, phone, email, and custom fields, with support for localization and portal integration.

methods.name: getFormBody
methods.description: Creates a simplified HTML form for contact data entry, used in various contexts like email or standard forms.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Builds the complete HTML form for creating or editing a contact, including headers, form fields, and submit button.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Processes form submission to save contact data, handle duplicates, inbound emails, and redirects accordingly.

methods.name: handleRedirect
methods.description: Redirects the user to the appropriate page after save, based on return module/action and other parameters.

methods.name: getContact
methods.description: Returns a new Contact bean instance.
